stories.title: RFK Jr. pledges support to vaccine skeptics as measles outbreak spreads
new_facts: RFK Jr. adds new members to USPSTF, seen as pushing panel toward administration's ideology
Kennedy launches new initiative to speed up autism diagnoses, calls current model outdated
RFK Jr. tells Children's Health Defense conference they have 'a friend' in the White House
Ties RFK's CHD speech to ongoing measles outbreak spreading in Pennsylvania
RFK claims the historic success of polio vaccines was a 'fraud'
RFK says he'd have made sweeping vaccine changes 'day one' but followed law; notes rising measles death toll
Specifies RFK Jr. added eight new members to USPSTF
stories.line: RFK Jr., now leading federal health policy, pledges support to vaccine skeptics while measles cases rise and he blocks a health advisory panel.

stories.title: Trump backs Fed official as rate hike scrutiny tests central bank independence
new_facts: Trump now backs Warsh after the rate hike; stocks rallied in response
GOP lawmakers express relief that Warsh defied Trump on rates

new_facts: FAA launching $875 million AI software program to help air traffic controllers manage flights.
New AI air-traffic tool to first roll out in Washington, D.C. area, as soon as Monday.

stories.title: Earl Spencer claims Charles was 'giddily elated' after Diana's death
new_facts: Insider report: William is 'furious' and King Charles's anger over Spencer's memoir claims is described as immense.
New quote: Charles allegedly sounded 'giddily elated, like a lottery winner' after Diana's death.
Spencer claims some Buckingham Palace staff were 'relieved' at Diana's death; details dispute over coffin procession.
stories.line: Earl Spencer claims in a new book that King Charles sounded unusually happy when told of Diana's death in 1997.

stories.title: Russia holds parliamentary elections amid war fatigue
new_facts: Russians vote for first time since 2022; question of whether opposition parties can challenge Putin's United Russia.
Fuel shortages, drone strikes, mobilization rumors and growing peace-talk support shape war-fatigued mood ahead of Russian parliamentary vote.
stories.line: Russians vote in parliamentary elections as public anxiety grows over the war in Ukraine and economic conditions.

stories.title: GOP lawmaker breaks with Trump over immigration enforcement
new_facts: New Fox News poll: 53% of voters say immigration enforcement has gone too far, consistent since June 2025
Freedom Caucus publicly rebukes Salazar over her anti-Trump immigration ad
Poll shows Trump's immigration approval at 43%, nearly erasing GOP's traditional edge on the issue
Notes Trump had endorsed Salazar's campaign just months before her critical ad
MAGA commentators label Salazar a 'traitor' after her ad; cites Trump's 2024 margin in her district as 15 points
stories.line: A Republican congresswoman faces backlash from her party after publicly criticizing Trump's immigration enforcement in a campaign ad.

stories.title: White House withdraws ICE nominee after Republican senator objects
new_facts: White House withdraws Trump's ICE director nominee after a Republican senator objects, demanding info on fatal ICE killings of US citizens.
Names the withdrawn ICE nominee as Lance Schroyer, a former Oklahoma state trooper.
Names Markwayne Mullin as DHS chief whom Schroyer advises and notes Senate Homeland Security chair pushed back on the nomination.
Identifies Sen. Rand Paul, Senate Homeland Security Committee chairman, as the Republican who blocked Schroyer's nomination.
stories.line: Trump withdrew his pick to lead ICE after a Republican senator objected to the nominee.

stories.title: Judge requires 30-day notice before Kennedy Center changes
new_facts: Judge Cooper ordered 30 days' written notice before any physical changes, including demolition, to Kennedy Center.
Kennedy Center spokesperson denies demolition plans; Trump quoted saying building could be 'ripped down'.
AFP photo shows Trump examining an image depicting apparent demolition of the Kennedy Center.
stories.line: A federal judge ordered the Trump administration to give 30 days' notice before making physical changes to the Kennedy Center, after Trump suggested demolishing it.

stories.title: Diana book sparks row between King and Earl Spencer over claims and title offers
new_facts: Queen Elizabeth allegedly offered to restore Diana's HRH title after her death, per Earl Spencer's memoir.
Diana allegedly told brother Charles was 'in love with his valet' before divorce; book named as 'Swan Song: Diana, My Sister'.
stories.line: A new book claims the Queen offered to restore Diana's title after her death; her brother alleges the King had a gay relationship.
